name: node-and-path
script: node -p 'JSON.stringify({node:process.version,exec:process.execPath,tmp:require("os").tmpdir(),home:require("os").homedir()})'; command -v rg || :; command -v GH || :; GH --version

name: protected-records
script: test ! -r "$TMPDIR/trace-reads/.key" && test ! -w "$TMPDIR/trace-reads" && node --test --test-name-pattern='own full reads|tells each agent|refuses tools.*read records' test/trace.test.mjs

name: test-owned-records
script: test ! -r "$TMPDIR/trace-reads/.key" && TMPDIR="$TMPDIR/test-owned" node --test --test-name-pattern='own full reads|tells each agent|refuses tools.*read records' test/trace.test.mjs

name: uppercase-gh
script: node --test --test-name-pattern='shell runs what the gates read' test/trace.test.mjs
